newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London flat, Sumitomo Metal up.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London flat, Sumitomo Metal up.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were little changed from their Tokyo close, with market attention focused on reports that Sumitomo Metal Mining Co had struck gold at a site in Alaska, traders said.
The 225-share Nikkei average closed down 147.54 points, or 0.81 percent, in Tokyo. In London the Nikkei 50 index was almost unchanged from that level, 0.86 percent lower than its Wednesday close.
Sumitomo Metal said after the close in Tokyo that a Japanese mining agency reported promising gold drilling results at the site, held by one of the company's U.S. subsidiaries.
Shares in the company climbed 29.81 yen from the Tokyo close to reach 800.81 yen, before settling at 797.5 yen by the close.
"That's been the main feature today," one trader said.
Elsewhere, Fuji Photo Film Co Ltd was heavily traded, though ended down 15 yen from the Tokyo close at 3,665 yen, along with Sony 7658.T, down 10 at 8,350 yen.
Banks also recovered some of their poise after recent concerns about their financial health in Tokyo. Fuji Bank was 7.5 yen up from the Tokyo close at 1247.5 and Sakura Bank gained five yen to 690.
